row.team_price_text: Lite: $13/mo for up to 500 contacts (monthly; priced by contacts, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Campaign Monitor's pricing page lists only multiple users, user roles & permissions and two-factor authentication under account settings; no SSO or SCIM appears there, in the API v3.3 reference or in the help centre.
row.notes: New row. Plans are priced by contact count, not per user (Lite $13, Essentials $31, Premier $171 per month for 0-500 contacts, read from the pricing page's selector markup; annual billing gives 10% off; Enterprise custom). Users are unlimited on paid plans. No SAML/OIDC SSO and no SCIM are documented, and the Okta catalogue app is password vaulting (SWA) only. The API v3.3 can add, update, list and delete account administrators and per-client people (access levels), using an API key or OAuth with the AdministerAccount/AdministerPersons scopes. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint, SSO or provisioning integration appears on the pricing page (which lists multiple users, user roles & permissions and two-factor authentication as the account settings), the API v3.3 reference, or the help-centre sitemap. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

endpoints.purpose: Update an administrator's email and/or name
Delete an administrator (status set to deleted; can no longer log in)
Add a person (client user) with an access level
Update a person's email, name and access level
List active or invited people in a client
Delete a person (status set to deleted; can no longer log in to the client)

rate_limits.text: Only /transactional endpoints are documented as rate limited; limit status is returned in response headers.

limitations.text: The last administrator on an account cannot be deleted.

user_api.notes: Users are account administrators and per-client 'people'. The pricing page lists API access in every plan's feature list.

okta.notes: OIN app marks only SWA as supported (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Microsoft Learn tutorial found (campaign-monitor-tutorial returns 404).

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited individually by email (API or UI); no SSO is documented, so there is no JIT.

open_questions: Does the Enterprise plan offer SAML SSO or SCIM under contract? Nothing public says so.
Does deleting an administrator or person free anything billable? Plans are priced by contacts, so probably not, but this is undocumented.
Is there an audit-log API? None found in API v3.3.
